scenarios.task: Tie rebar cages for flame trench wall repair at Launch Complex 39A.
steps: Attend hazard briefing and review trench shoring plan
Inspect rebar caps and shoring before entry
Tie vertical and horizontal bars to spec spacing
Signal crane for cage panel delivery
Check tie wire ends are bent flat
Exit trench before any load moves
Log completed sections for inspector

rubric.pass_if: Verifies trench shoring before entry and after any change
Bar spacing within tolerance before pour signoff
Clears trench during all crane movements

scenarios.task: Weld replacement steel lobe panels on the pad's fixed service structure at 39A.
steps: Pull hot work permit and fire watch assignment
Tack panel into place and check fit-up gap
Run root pass, inspect, then fill and cap
Grind and inspect welds for cracks
Fire watch stays 30 minutes after arc stops
Complete weld log for QA

rubric.pass_if: Hot work permit and fire watch active for all arc-on time
No undercut or cracks found on visual inspection
Tied off 100% at height

scenarios.task: Re-wrap cryogenic LOX line insulation in the fuel yard near the pad.
steps: Review oxygen-enrichment cleanup procedure
De-ice walking surfaces before starting
Remove damaged insulation lagging
Wrap new cryo-rated insulation and vapor barrier
Secure banding without over-compressing wrap
Ventilate work area before any hot work nearby
Tag line for systems inspection

rubric.pass_if: Uses cryo-rated insulation with intact vapor barrier
No ignition sources introduced; clothing freed of O2 residue before breaks
No gaps or compressed spots in finished wrap

scenarios.task: Replace damaged ground conductor on a pad lightning protection tower.
steps: Check weather and lightning launch commit criteria
Obtain clearance and verify de-energization with test
Ground the conductor before handling
Climb with 100% tie-off and install new conductor
Torque hardware to spec and verify continuity path
Remove grounds only after clearance and tool count
File work completion with systems

rubric.pass_if: Tests for absence of voltage before contact
Descends before any lightning criteria violation
Continuity test passes after install

scenarios.task: Re-verify pad reference monuments and settle monitoring points around 39A.
steps: Review existing control network records
Set instrument over primary monument and level precisely
Shoot redundant angles and distances to check points
Record deltas against prior survey epochs
Flag any movement beyond tolerance to engineering
Pack out all equipment and flagging
File settlement report to Progress Tracker

rubric.pass_if: Traverse closes within stated tolerance
All deltas logged and compared to prior epochs
Maintains visibility to traffic and avoids wildlife encounters

scenarios.task: Repair marsh boardwalk decking on the public causeway leading toward the pad viewpoint.
steps: Check tide table and stage materials above high-tide line
Inspect ledger and joists for rot before loading deck
Remove failed boards and pull or drive protruding fasteners
Cut and fasten replacement boards with gap spacing
Verify railing posts are sound and tight
Sweep and inspect for exposed fastener points
Report structural issues to foreman

rubric.pass_if: Joists and ledgers inspected before deck loading
No proud or missed fasteners remain
Spacing gaps allow water drainage

scenarios.task: Characterize and treat residual propellant contamination in the pad deluge retention pond.
steps: Review site history and draft sampling plan
Set exclusion zone and place air monitoring downwind
Sample pond water at multiple depths and locations
Log readings and compare against action levels
Apply neutralizing treatment per plan
Decontaminate equipment and suits before exit
Deliver results and disposal records to steward review

rubric.pass_if: Continuous air monitoring during all entries
Multiple locations and depths sampled with chain of custody
Full decontamination before leaving exclusion zone

scenarios.task: Change HEPA filters on air handlers serving the hangar processing facility.
steps: Lock out fan motors and verify zero energy
Stage replacement filters and bag old filters in place
Remove and bag old HEPA filters without shaking
Clean filter rack and check gasket condition
Install new filters with correct airflow arrow orientation
Restore power and verify pressure drop across bank
Dispose of bags per waste procedure

rubric.pass_if: Locks applied and verified before rack opening
Old filters bagged in place, no dust release
Correct orientation and no gasket bypass
